messages:
sam: Onboarding new tenant (org-id: rwd-tenant-142). Need to pre-provision GPUs in us-east-2. Requesting increases for p5, p4d, and g5. Can ops help with quota requests?

maya: Do you have the AWS account ID + target counts? Also any ENI/EBS concerns?

sam: Account: 123456789012. Targets: p5.xlarge -> 8, p4d.24xlarge -> 2, g5.12xlarge -> 12. Also requesting ENI limit bump to 3500 and EBS gp3 throughput quota to 2000. Justification: steady inference load for paid tenants, SLA-backed. Cost center: infra-tenant-onboard. Start date: 2026-04-01.

irene: OK. Please add a short justification to the support case and include expected start date + cost center. I'll submit via Service Quotas and flag with our account rep. Also add tag 'enterprise-onboard' to the case.

sam: Created AWS support case #9876543210 and Service Quotas request id sq-0a1b2c3d. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?displayId=9876543210

infra-bot: quota increase submitted: case 9876543210 -> p5:8, p4d:2, g5:12, ENI:3500. ETA 3-5 business days. Ticket SQ-2026-176 created :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks. Once approved, we'll schedule provisioning and update the onboarding runbook (runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-onboard).

sam: Also, can someone confirm whether us-east-2 has p5 stock in our preferred AZs? If not, fallback to us-east-1. We want AZ-aware placement for NCCL for p4d.

irene: I'll ping the cloud rep and check reserved capacity options. Note: p4d requires colocated networking; may need cross-AZ adjustments.

maya: tagging @ops-oncall for awareness during rollout window.

ops-oncall: ACK. Will monitor quota change and watch for provisioning failures. If quotas are approved, I'll run the capacity smoke tests (gpu-check.sh) and post results here.
